description_en: Modifies the permissions of a database account
kebab_example: aliyun clickhouse modify-account-authority --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id cc-bp108z124a8o70000 --account-name test --dml-authority all --ddl-authority true --allow-databases db1 --allow-dictionaries dt1 --api-version 2019-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyAccountAuthority

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/170875.html接口查询地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The DML permissions granted to the database account. Valid values:

all: Grants read, write, and modify permissions.

readonly,modify: Grants read and modify permissions
parameters.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DML权限，取值说明：

all：读写和设置权限。
readonly,modify：读取和设置权限
parameters.name: dml_authority

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to grant DDL permissions to the database account. Valid values:

true: Allows DDL operations.

false: Denies DDL operations
parameters.help_zh:
是否授予数据库账号DDL权限，取值说明：

true：允许DDL。
false：禁止DDL
parameters.name: ddl_authority

parameters.help_en: The list of databases to authorize. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的数据库列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: allow_databases

parameters.help_en: All databases in the cluster. Separate multiple database names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 所有数据库列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: total_databases

parameters.help_en: The list of dictionaries to authorize. Separate multiple dictionary names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 需要授权的字典列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: allow_dictionaries

parameters.help_en: All dictionaries in the cluster. Separate multiple dictionary names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 所有字典列表。如果有多个，用“,”隔开
parameters.name: total_dictionaries
